overfit_corpus.selection: numeric fixture ids r1a-00000 through r1a-08191 inclusive, in ascending order
overfit_corpus.target: R1-A handcrafted static score in side-to-move orientation
overfit_corpus.loss: mean squared error between sigmoid(prediction / 410) and sigmoid(target / 410)

targets.coalesced_material: linear target coalesced material score / 1000 using the nine frozen trainer piece slots
targets.sentinel_feature_rows: sixteen-output identity target from signed side-to-move-oriented production feature-row counts

deployment_overfit.graph: complete 512x8 DonorSingleEff deployment checkpoint; trained coefficients use the bucketed PSQT branch and all other parameters remain zero
deployment_overfit.optimizer: deterministic full-batch conjugate-gradient least squares in PyTorch float64

quantization.apply_to: all, each even/odd fixture-id split, each reference-score bucket, and every split/score-bucket cross

collision_diagnostic.coalesced_slot: Gold, Tokin, promoted Lance, promoted Knight, and promoted Silver
collision_diagnostic.assertions: each substitution pair has identical packed bytes and active features but the frozen handcrafted material component differs by exactly 50 runtime score units in absolute value

pass_rule: PASS iff every exact oracle satisfies its frozen ratio, full-precision overfit loss is at most 10% of initial loss, serialized loss retains at least 90% of the full-precision reduction, all frozen R1-B absolute group limits pass, repeat exports are byte-identical, Python integer scores equal Rust full-refresh and incremental scores exactly, serializer clamps and accumulator overflows are zero, and the collision diagnostic is complete.
